name: Angels
overview: Scripture reveals angels as mighty, holy beings created by God and Christ who serve as ministering spirits executing God's purposes and judgments. They are depicted as protectors and guides for believers, as seen in their charge to keep and deliver those who fear the Lord (Psalms 34:7; 91:11; Exodus 23:20). Angels also worship and celebrate God’s praises with strength and reverence (Psalms 103:20; Isaiah 6:2), and communicate divine will, exemplified by Gabriel’s swift ministry in Daniel 9:21. Importantly, all angels are subject to Christ’s authority, highlighting their role within God’s sovereign plan.
